propositions: scc LOC adapter invokes scc binary via subprocess.run with --format json and parses per-file Code/Location fields into AnalyzerResult.loc payload
scc JSON structure is two-level (data list of language groups, each with Files array); parser must flatten both levels to extract all per-file entries
adapter fails closed (returns Unavailable with reason and _ACCRUING_SINCE) when scc binary missing, exits non-zero, stdout empty, or JSON unparseable; emits logger.warning
successful empty output (scc returns []) produces AnalyzerResult with empty files dict and max_loc=0, not Unavailable
Location paths are repo-relativized and POSIX-normalized before use as dict keys; max_loc is max(files.values()) or 0 if empty
analyzers package stays independent of grounding layer; scc JSON extraction (~10 lines) not shared with grounding._scc_files (YAGNI, deferred to Rule-of-Three)
